name: Topo Credits
tagline: Topographic contours that draw themselves, a bloom of red ink and widely spaced serif credits.
description: Cinematic title-sequence style for films, documentaries, trailers and premium brand intros. Pale contour lines draw outward from a summit on black letterbox while the map slowly turns, one contour traces in red, a blurred red ink bloom grows inside a drawn ring as credits resolve from blur, and the title settles over faint contours with a thin red rule.

body.usage: Credit names 44px tracking 0.32em; roles 22px muted tracking 0.4em

transitions: hard cut to black between the map and the ink bloom
letterbox bars stay fixed for the whole piece
textAnimations: credits resolve from blur(6px) while rising 14px
title resolves from blur(14px) and scale 1.04
thin red rule grows from the centre under the title

rhythm.notes: Three long shots. Each credit holds at least 1.5s; nothing moves fast except the contour draw-on.

guide:
- Black #070707 with permanent 110px letterbox bars; the only colour is red #c4161c.
- Contours are 16–18 closed SVG paths built from layered sine wobbles around one summit; vary stroke weight every fourth line and fade opacity outward. Draw them outward with a small stagger.
- Keep the map slowly rotating and scaling (linear) under the credits; trace one contour in red after the draw.
- Ink blooms are a few blurred (40–50px) red ellipses scaling up at different times inside a thin drawn ring.
- Credits: uppercase Cormorant Garamond, role small and muted above the name, very wide tracking; resolve from blur, never slide far.
- End on the title with a short red rule and one quiet line (release window).
